title: Grateful Dead Live at Feyline Field on 1973-11-25
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition 2020 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Smokin' show captured on a patched soundboard release with great, crystal‑clear sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave that the concert is a "smokin'" performance and praise the superb audio quality after Miller’s upgrades. The soundboard source delivers a clean, well‑balanced mix that lets the high energy of the night shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and highlighted both the show’s intensity and the excellent sound quality, indicating a top‑tier performance and recording despite the limited number of reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great sound; Miller's patched restoration yields clear, crisp audio with no noted issues.
